title: Submit a contact inquiry successfully
description: A visitor can complete the contact form and receive a success confirmation after submitting required details.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the organization field with a valid organization name
Fill in the message field with a valid inquiry message
Submit the contact form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
